summary: A +1 longbow with +3 Initiative and Advantage on Perception checks.

fields.Fiendish Fire: Once per turn, a hit from this bow forces a DC 13 Dexterity save or applies Faerie Fire until the start of the target’s next turn. Other damage can prompt a hidden save but does not apply the effect.
fields.Base value: 770 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Initiative and perception: +3 Initiative and advantage on Perception checks.
